import sys
import re

def main():
    # Read first token from stdin (same as Scanner.next() with whitespace delimiter)
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    # Pattern to match consecutive identical characters
    pattern = re.compile(r'(.)\1*')
    result = 0
    for match in pattern.finditer(s):
        if len(match.group()) % 2 == 0:
            result += 1
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
